format: Single 4-second presenter intro clip. Controlled proof test, not a finished advert.

scene.description: A professional British business presenter speaks one short line directly to camera in a modern office.
scene.spoken_line: Welcome to Cloudtech. Let us get started.

music_direction.intent: An extremely subtle instrumental background bed that sits quietly underneath the single spoken line and fades cleanly after the speech.
music_direction.instrumentation: warm low-frequency ambient pad with very light texture only
music_direction.energy: minimal and static, no movement or build
music_direction.fade: gentle fade in, clean fade out within the clip
avoid: any reference to a specific artist or song

notes: Keep the bed minimal and quiet so it barely sits under the speech. This proves the music bridge end to end; it is not the final campaign.
